result.title: Resistance training volume and hypertrophy in trained women: a randomized trial of 10 versus 20 weekly sets.

journal.title: Medicine and science in sports and exercise

result.abstractText: Forty trained women performed 10 or 20 weekly sets per muscle for 12 weeks. Both groups gained muscle; differences were small.

result.title: Weekly set volume and muscle growth in recreationally trained adults: a randomized crossover trial
result.abstractText:
Background

Twenty-four adults trained each leg with 8 or 16 weekly sets.

Results

Growth was similar between legs.

result.title: Volume landmarks for hypertrophy: a large online survey of lifters
result.abstractText: We surveyed 2058 lifters about their weekly sets and self-reported growth.
